h: The Dor'Danil Barrow Den: kill these as you meet them

l.x: The Forsaken's camp lies in the woods south of Forest Song. Rusty chests lie around the Shadethicket furbolg camps west of the Forsaken; open them until one holds the pommel. Careful: Non-elite Forsaken of about level 28-30 guard the camp. Some of them are stealthed, and the ones around the table often aggro together.
Récupérez 1 × Pommeau en fer (Coffre rouillé)
Récupérez 1 × Bouteille des maladies (Bouteille des maladies)

The Oracle Sombretaillis walks the shore of Le lac Tombeciel, south-west of the chests; the Pendentif de lune resplendissante lies north of the lake, on the way. Careful: Other mobs, some of them underwater, sit near the island. Clear them first so they don't join the fight when you pull the Oracle.
Récupérez 1 × Pierre de lune tombée sur Oracle Sombretaillis
Acceptez « Gleaming Crescent Necklace » (Pendentif de lune resplendissante) — Pendentif de lune resplendissante : pour Maliynn à Astranaar

The three druids stand together at the Forsaken camp south of Forest Song. Careful: The den has many mobs that respawn quickly, including stealthed undead and patrols, so extra mobs often join a fight.
